purpose: REST-endpoint specs for the Lofty MCP server, mechanically generated from specs/openapi.json by scripts/generate_rest_specs.py (one file per OpenAPI tag). Supersedes the old CLI-based specs/cli/*.json entirely — lofty-cli cannot authenticate with the credential this project uses (see authCorrection below), so the server calls https://api.lofty.com directly.
sourceSpec: specs/openapi.json (102 operations, 27 tags, OpenAPI 3.0.1, server https://api.lofty.com)

authCorrection.problem: Every operation in specs/openapi.json documents 'Authorization: Bearer [access_token]' as a required header parameter. That header parameter is stripped out of every specs/rest/*.json operation entry (it's transport-level, injected by src/lofty_mcp/rest_client.py, never a tool-facing argument) — but the scheme it documents is also simply wrong for the credential this project has.
authCorrection.empiricalFinding: This project's credential is a REST personal-access API key (Lofty CRM → Settings → Integrations → API). Verified 2026-08-12 directly against GET https://api.lofty.com/v1.0/leads: 'Authorization: token <key>' → HTTP 200 with real data (454 leads). 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' → HTTP 400 {"code":200058,"message":"User in token does not exist."}. The same Bearer rejection was independently reproduced via lofty-cli (a completely different client), confirming it's a real API-level rejection, not a client bug.
authCorrection.conclusion: Always send 'Authorization: token {LOFTY_API_KEY}'. Never Bearer. This is the single most load-bearing fact in this spec set.

noRefreshLogic: This credential has 'configurable expiration' per the REST auth docs and no documented refresh flow (unlike OAuth access/refresh token pairs). src/lofty_mcp/rest_client.py does not retry or refresh on 401 — it raises a clear error telling the user to regenerate the key in Settings → Integrations → API.

versionDecisions.why: v2 is a strict superset: adds finish/unfinish and my-tasks (GET /v2.0/tasks/my-tasks) that v1 lacks entirely. Matches what the old CLI wrapper (src/tools/tasksAppointments.ts, now deleted) targeted.

versionDecisions.decision: Mixed: send-sms/send-email stay v1 (only version); call-history uses the v2-flavored endpoint that's still under the /v1.0 path prefix (GET /v1.0/communication/call/v2); email/text history stay plain v1 (no v2 variant exists); agent-communication search uses GET /v2.0/communication/agent, not POST /v1.0/agent/communication.
versionDecisions.why: GET /v1.0/communication/call/v2's own description says it includes 'additional event types not covered by the v1 variant' with an identical parameter shape (leadId, offset, limit, currentId) — strictly better, same signature, trivial swap. For agent-communication, GET /v2.0/communication/agent is a clean cursor-paginated GET (type/startTime/endTime/limit/cursor/teamView query params) vs. the v1 POST with a full CommunicationRequest JSON body — GET+query-params matches the tool's existing filter-style interface much better.

resources.notes: v1, superseded by tasks-appointments-v2 for this project — kept only for reference.
leads.json also has GET /v1.0/leads/{leadId}/activities — confirm overlap before implementing this one.
Single GET /v1.0/vendor/list endpoint — trivial to add.
Registers an external callback URL — more consequential than the read-mostly tools; consider gating/confirmation if implemented.

sixtyFourBitIds: Not a concern in this Python implementation. Python's int is arbitrary-precision and httpx's .json() (stdlib json) parses large integers natively — unlike the deleted TypeScript version, no 'never coerce to Number' discipline is needed anywhere in this codebase.
regenerating: Run `python scripts/generate_rest_specs.py` (inside the project's Docker image, per project convention — see README) after re-fetching specs/openapi.json from https://developer.lofty.com/openapi/openapi.json if Lofty's API surface changes. It overwrites every specs/rest/*.json except this index.json, which is hand-maintained.
